name: peak-player
description: Peak Player - 离线音频播放器
author: Peak Player

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run check:coverage
scripts.package:win: node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.mjs --platform=win32 --arch=x64 && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win && node scripts/check-package.mjs
scripts.package:mac: node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.mjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac && node scripts/check-package.mjs
scripts.package:linux: node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.mjs --platform=linux --arch=x64 && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux && node scripts/check-package.mjs
